Ghanaian singer-songwriter RCee is set to headline 'RCee Live' on December 22 as part of AfroFuture’s Future Club activation, adding another major performance to his growing live music profile.
The performance will see the emerging highlife artiste take centre stage during one of the activities lined up for the December festive season, bringing his music to audiences through a dedicated live show.
RCee, known for blending contemporary highlife with afrobeats, reggae and R&B influences, has been building a following through his smooth vocals, songwriting and energetic stage performances.
His headline appearance will provide an opportunity to showcase songs from his growing catalogue, including ‘Agenda’, ‘Atiaa’, ‘Knees & Bend’ and ‘Money Makes the World Go Round’.
The Future Club activation is part of AfroFuture’s wider programme of music and cultural experiences, bringing together artistes and audiences during Ghana’s busy December entertainment season.
For RCee, the December 22 performance marks another step in his efforts to expand his audience and strengthen his presence within Ghana’s contemporary music scene.
Tickets for RCee Live are available through the event's online sales platform. Get tickets here .
